apps.localizedDescription: ramus is a genre-first music client for Plex focused on discovering and exploring your existing library. Out of the box It's designed to function with the metadata plex has already assigned your albums to give you a rich hierarchical tree-like view of your library, while genre-obsessives can go as deep and custom as they wish and browse by their own dream musical taxonomy.
apps.versionDescription: overhauled mobile now playing view, made art colour scheme sourcing better, added an oled black display option, overhauled search, added a duration filter for suggested albums (doing a 45 minute commute? find 45 minute albums. nice), overhauled a lot of logic for connections and resiliency specifically when on weak cellular or spotty connections or jumping between wifi and cell service. inspired by a few very annoying train journeys, added a system to import rich genre metadata should you have some of that for some reason (maybe eventually i'll be in a position to ship with that courtesy of a kind benefactor source) overhauled lyrics on mobile, fixed plex local sidecar .lrc lyric file logic so it actually works, fixed numerous misc little bugs

Initial SideStore source. The iOS build is produced by the unified release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) and uploaded as an ad-hoc-signed IPA — SideStore re-signs it with your Apple ID at install time.
